title: ExecuteRequest v0.1
description: M3.4 IDE Plugin execution request. Routes through Plan-Gate before sandbox.

timestamp_utc.description: Request creation timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC

task_id.description: Optional task ID for multi-step workflows

plan_hash.description: Plan hash if this relates to a prior plan

ledger_path.description: Optional path for SQLite ledger store; when set, Plan-Gate decision and sandbox outcome are persisted

plan_gate_refuse.description: Test/demo only: force Plan-Gate posture to refuse. Do not use for production policy.

plan_gate_defer.description: Test/demo only: force Plan-Gate posture to defer. Do not use for production policy.

plan_gate_bounded_allow.description: Test/demo only: force Plan-Gate posture to bounded_allow. Do not use for production policy.
